records.title: Time series
records.summary: Use when order over time matters; label units, range, sampling, and comparison, and avoid implying continuity the data lacks.

records.title: Category comparison
records.summary: Use aligned bars for magnitude comparisons; keep baselines honest and labels close to the values.

records.title: Distribution
records.summary: Use a distribution view when spread, skew, or outliers matter more than a single average.

records.title: Part to whole
records.summary: Use a simple part-to-whole view only for a small number of meaningful categories with a common total.

records.title: Comparison table
records.summary: Use a table when exact values, multiple attributes, sorting, or accessible row-by-row comparison matter.
